name: Pretty Candead!
source:
Main character runs apartment after his parents. One day three girls dressed as devils come over to him. He involuntary signs a contract with them in exchange for three wishes. In addition, he gets to live with these lusty beings for a month together.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-may-2003-ashita-deatta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
